title: Statistics - Lesson 5: Box-and-Whisker Plots Practice
description: Practice constructing and interpreting box-and-whisker plots from five-number summaries.

questions.question: Which list shows the values in a five-number summary in the correct order?
questions.explanation: A five-number summary is always written as minimum, Q1, median, Q3, and maximum.

questions.question: For the ordered data set 4, 7, 9, 10, 13, what is the median? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: There are five values, so the middle value is the third value, 9.

questions.question: A five-number summary is 6, 11, 15, 19, 24. Which values are the ends of the box?
questions.explanation: The box runs from Q1 to Q3, so its ends are 11 and 19.

questions.question: In a box-and-whisker plot, the median is shown as a line inside the box.
questions.explanation: The box goes from Q1 to Q3, and the median is marked with a line inside the box.

questions.question: For the five-number summary 8, 12, 17, 20, 29, what is the interquartile range? Enter just the number.
Which statement correctly interprets a long right whisker?
options: The highest quarter of values is more spread out.
Most values are in the right whisker.
The median must be the largest value.
The data set has no maximum.
questions.explanation: Each section represents about one quarter of the data. A longer section means more spread, not more data points.

questions.question: A student draws the box from the minimum to the maximum. Explain the mistake in one or two sentences.
questions.correctAnswer: The box should be drawn from Q1 to Q3, not from the minimum to the maximum. The whiskers extend from the box to the minimum and maximum.
questions.explanation: This checks the main structure of a box plot: box edges are quartiles, and whisker ends are extremes.

questions.question: Describe the steps for constructing a box-and-whisker plot from a five-number summary.
questions.correctAnswer: Draw a scaled number line, mark the minimum, Q1, median, Q3, and maximum, draw a box from Q1 to Q3, draw the median line, and extend whiskers to the minimum and maximum.
questions.explanation: A complete construction response includes the scale, the five marked values, the box, median line, and whiskers.
